title: Unlicensed imported vitamin D (colecalciferol) capsules: potential peanut oil and soya oil allergens
authors: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
journal: MHRA Drug Safety Update, volume 5, issue 8, March 2012: S2 (republished on GOV.UK 11 December 2014)
funder: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
result: Vigantoletten and Dekristol colecalciferol capsules, unlicensed in the UK and imported in German-language packaging for individual patients, contain soya oil and arachis (peanut) oil respectively, which is unlikely to be evident to non-German speakers; imported Osto D2 and Drisdol capsules may pose a similar risk. Allergy to soya oil or arachis oil may lead to severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis; these products are contraindicated in patients with relevant allergies, and doctors and pharmacists should ask about allergies before supply.
